properties.title: Config Mount Host Path
properties.description: Host path to the Pi config directory. Override if your config is stored elsewhere.

properties.title: Config Mount Container Path
properties.description: Mount point inside the sandbox container.

properties.title: Config Mount Mode
properties.description: Read-write or read-only access to the Pi config directory inside the sandbox container. Read-write is required because Pi writes session files and settings to this directory.

properties.title: Config Mount Env Key
properties.description: Environment variable name for the config host path, used in non-sandbox mode. Set to empty to disable.

properties.title: Config Mount Env Value
properties.description: Environment variable value for the config host path, used in non-sandbox mode.

agent.description: Pi is a full coding agent that handles its own LLM calls, tool execution, and reasoning. When selected, Pi runs inside the task's worktree and manages the entire task lifecycle.
agent.setup_info:
- **Inherited Config:** Your existing configuration is used when tasks are executed. Therefore all configuration of Pi should be done within Pi itself.
- **Sandbox:**
  - Your sandbox image must include `pi` on `$PATH`.
  - Pi's config directory (`~/.pi/agent/`) is bind-mounted into the container at `/root/.pi/agent` (read-write by default, required for session files).
  - An example dockerfile can be found in `./extensions/agent/pi/dockerfile-example`.
- **Sessions:** Each task gets its own Pi session (named `kanban-{task-id}`) for continuity across restarts.
